 OPPO 11.11 Sale: Win a Hong Kong Disneyland Trip
 By Wazzup.PH - November 9, 2026 0 22 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Save also up to Php8,000 on select devices as OPPO kicks off its Christmas campaign with  loads of freebies and prizes up for grabs 
 Your next tech upgrade could unlock a magical Disney adventure! This 11.11, OPPO is making holiday shopping even more exciting with discounts of up to ₱8,000 and exclusive freebies on selected devices. Whether you’re treating yourself to the latest technology or surprising someone special, you can enjoy these exciting deals through OPPO’s official online stores on Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop until November 13, 2026 .
 But the excitement doesn’t end with great deals. Kicking off on November 11, OPPO’s Christmas campaign gives eligible online shoppers the opportunity to experience the magic of Hong Kong Disneyland . Imagine stepping into your favorite Disney stories, meeting beloved characters, and exploring enchanting themed lands filled with exciting attractions and spectacular entertainment—all while capturing unforgettable memories with your OPPO smartphone.
 Two lucky grand prize winners will each take home a five-day, four-night Hong Kong Disneyland travel package worth ₱500,000 , bringing the combined grand prize value to an incredible ₱1 million .
 Make Your Wishlist Go Further with OPPO’s 11.11 Deals
 Get a head start on your holiday wishlist with exciting savings on OPPO’s latest devices. Capture memorable festive moments with a new smartphone, enjoy work and entertainment on a tablet, or bring your favorite holiday playlists wherever you go with wireless earbuds.
 Whatever you’re looking for, there’s an OPPO deal worth checking out.
 Lazada 
 ₱1,000 off: OPPO Enco Air5, OPPO Enco Air5s, OPPO Reno15 5G, and OPPO A6t
 ₱2,000 off: OPPO Pad SE WiFi/LTE, OPPO Bubble, and OPPO A6c
 ₱3,000 off: OPPO A6s
 ₱4,000 off: OPPO Find X9
 ₱5,000 off: Reno13
 ₱6,000 off: Reno14 Pro
 ₱7,000 off: Reno12 Pro
 ₱8,000 off: OPPO Reno16 Series
 TikTok Shop 
 ₱1,000 off: OPPO Enco Air5, OPPO Enco Air5s, and OPPO Reno15 Series
 ₱2,000 off: OPPO Pad SE WiFi/LTE, OPPO A6x, OPPO A6t, and OPPO Bubble
 ₱4,000 off: OPPO Find X9
 ₱8,000 off: OPPO Reno16 Series
 Shopee 
 ₱1,000 off: OPPO Enco Air5 and OPPO Enco Air5s
 ₱2,000 off: OPPO Bubble (available from November 1–10 and November 12 onwards)
 ₱4,000 off: OPPO Find X9
 ₱8,000 off: OPPO Reno16 Series (available from November 1–10 and November 12 onwards)
 Unbox Extra Joy with Exclusive Gifts
 Make your holiday upgrade even more rewarding with complimentary gifts on selected OPPO purchases. From useful accessories to added convenience, these freebies give you more reasons to celebrate your next device upgrade.
 OPPO Pad SE: Free OPPO Pad SE Case
 OPPO Reno16 Series: Free 10,000mAh power bank
 OPPO Reno15 Series: Free 10,000mAh power bank
 OPPO Watch S: Free Watch S Strap
 OPPO A7 Pro 5G: Free Tango Jet Earbuds worth ₱1,699, while supplies last
 Customers purchasing the OPPO A7 Pro can also enjoy an additional ₱100 GCash cashback until December 11.
 Three Carols Could Bring You Closer to Disney Magic
 Your dream Disney vacation may be just three Carols away! Through OPPO’s Maligayang PaskOPPO celebration, eligible participants can join the holiday festivities and earn a chance to win by completing these three simple steps:
 1st Carol: Visit and Pre-register Visit any participating OPPO Official Online Store and complete your pre-registration through the Maligayang PaskOPPO Digital Caroling Pass .
 2nd Carol: Purchase and Link Your Device Purchase an eligible OPPO smartphone and link your newly purchased device to the My OPPO App to participate in the AGUINALDOPPO Instant Draw , where you can win exclusive freebies or vouchers.
 3rd Carol: Share Your Christmas Moment Share your holiday experience by commenting on the designated Maligayang PaskOPPO thread in the My OPPO App PH Circle (O-Community) .
 Each eligible My OPPO user can complete one Digital Caroling Pass and earn a maximum of one Grand Raffle entry throughout the promotional period, regardless of the number of qualifying purchases. Every eligible entry provides another opportunity to win, although participation does not guarantee a prize.
 Once the three Carols are completed, the countdown to the grand draw begins! The Grand Raffle draw will take place on January 31, 2027 , with winners selected electronically in accordance with the approved Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) mechanics.
 Stay tuned to OPPO Philippines’ official social media channels and the My OPPO App for the official winner announcements. You could be among the lucky participants heading off on a magical holiday adventure!
 More Prizes to Spread the Holiday Cheer
 The Maligayang PaskOPPO Grand Raffle will have 1,277 winners in total , including the two lucky grand prize recipients of the Hong Kong Disneyland travel package.
 Other exciting prizes up for grabs include:
 OPPO smartphones: OPPO A3x (4GB+64GB), OPPO Reno12 Pro 5G (12GB+512GB), and OPPO A5 Pro or A6t Pro
 Audio devices: OnePlus Nord Buds2 and OPPO Enco Buds2 Pro
 Personal care devices: YOOSE Nano Electric Razor and YOOSE Electric Shaver (Mini 2.0) Silver
 SMAC rewards: 3,000 SMAC Points and 1,000 SMAC Points
 Digital vouchers: ₱300 Grab Voucher, ₱100 SM Gift Pass, ₱100 ShopeePay, and ₱100 GCash
 Digital vouchers must be redeemed within 60 days from the winning date , subject to the applicable redemption conditions. Physical Grand Raffle prizes will be delivered to winners’ registered addresses following successful verification.
 ‘Shop to Win’ Travel Luggage for Your Next Adventure
 There’s even more holiday excitement waiting for OPPO online shoppers! Whether you’re upgrading your smartphone or choosing the perfect gift for someone special, your purchase could also bring home a travel-ready surprise.
 Running from November 1 to 10, 2026 , OPPO’s ‘Shop to Win’ early raffle gives 11 lucky shoppers the chance to win travel luggage for their upcoming adventures. Whether you’re planning a long-awaited homecoming or a spontaneous weekend getaway, imagine packing your new OPPO device alongside your holiday essentials and setting off to create unforgettable memories.
 Here’s how to join:
 Earn raffle entries: Customers receive one (1) raffle entry for every purchase of any OPPO device made through the OPPO Official Stores on Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop .
 Promo period: The promotion runs from November 1, 2026, at 12:00 AM until November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM.
 Prizes: Eleven (11) lucky winners will each receive one (1) travel luggage.
 Raffle draw and winner notification: The draw will take place on November 27, 2026. Winners will be contacted through Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop Chat and provided with instructions on how to claim their prizes.
 Make your holiday shopping more exciting with OPPO and discover a season filled with incredible deals, exclusive gifts, and magical surprises.
 For more information about the 11.11 Sale and Christmas campaign, visit www.oppo.com/ph and follow OPPO Philippines on its official Facebook page.
 DTI Fair Trade Permit No. FTEB-271140 Series of 2026.
